purpose: Human-reviewed acceptance decisions for the future Leaf v3 manifest. This registry is not a training manifest.

frozen_base.policy: Never edit or relabel the frozen base in place. Any inherited record used by Leaf v3 must have its own provenance and acceptance decision; historical validation/test records are not eligible for new training.

decision_policy.legacy_class_29_migration: The registry must contain exactly one decision per frozen clean_v2 manifest record containing legacy class ID 29. Each decision must be migrated, excluded, quarantined, or pending; a locked registry may contain no pending decisions. A migrated record must join to one accepted inherited_train_record with matching frozen image/label hashes, group, and reviewed new class IDs.
prohibitions: A source-class proposal, visual triage, geometry audit, or no-match result is not acceptance.
Do not infer a disease, healthy state, or crop from appearance alone when the source label is unknown or contradictory.
Do not treat a candidate overlap/group-closure disposition as a final split assignment.
Do not accept a source copy as a new independent example when its decoded image is already in the frozen base.
Do not migrate legacy cucumber class 29 to healthy or a disease without a per-record, source-backed decision.
